newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end higher, focus on BMC.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end higher, focus on BMC.

text.p: 1700 GMT - Portuguese shares closed slightly firmer with activity focused on Banco Mello Comercial which accounted for more than 50 percent of total turnover. A large stake held by American International Group (AIG) was transferred from Banco Mello de Investimentos, which is no longer listed, to BMC. BMC closed at 1,350 escudos, up 15, in volume of 2,694,401 shares.

* Dealers said they expected the Lisbon share market to remain steady tomorrow with turnover concentrated on cement group Cimpor, Portugal Telecom and Credito Predial Portugues (CPP). Trade in CPP was due to rumours that Banco Pinto & Sotto Mayor was considering a possible sale of the bank.
* BPI rose slightly, reflecting its strong nine-month profit results, dealers said. BPI closed at 1,823 escudos, up 18, in volume of 99,284 shares.
